complexity.notes: Correct and minimal. The follow-up asks for a non-sorting solution: ||quickselect (Hoare's selection algorithm)|| achieves O(n) average time, and a ||min-heap of size k|| achieves O(n log k); both avoid the O(n log n) sort.
complexity.summary: Sorts a copy of the array and returns the element k positions from the end, which is the kth largest.
